title: Interface to JDemetra+ 3.x time series analysis software
text: {rjd3providers} provides tools explore default time series providers (.xslx, .csv, .txt .xml files) JDemetra+ v3.x Graphical User Interface. allows manipulate raw series files. example, using R package, able : change path raw data change file type manipulate monikers change file read properties

title: Interface to JDemetra+ 3.x time series analysis software
